_comment: A spell's additional sacrifice cost that names what it sacrificed -- Life's Legacy's shape, standing in for it. Test-only; read by tests/unit/costs/test_spell_sacrifice_binding.py.

cards.name: Test Legacy
cards.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
Draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.

cards.name: Test Optional Legacy
cards.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may sacrifice a creature.
Draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
